settings.name: OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE
settings.description: The profile this process runs under: development, or production, which is also what unset means

when_wrong.detail: Anything but development, in any case and trimmed, runs as production; rar-model alone reads development only when it is written exactly so (F-0160)

settings.name: OIDF_ACCEPTED_RISKS
settings.description: The risky switches this deployment accepts in production, comma-separated, each a risk id alone or with the last day it holds (expiry-log-mode@2026-12-31, UTC)

when_wrong.detail: An entry that is empty, not a risk this release knows, dated wrongly or past its date, repeated, or without the date a dated risk needs is not accepted, and the start-up audit lists it; nothing refuses a deployment for it until PR-5
